Interpretation: WS-DREAM response-time data cleaned, transformed to quality score, and malicious users injected.
PCC, Cosine Similarity, AOI filtering, and Top K neighbour selection were implemented.
BFS-based trust diffusion with depth decay was implemented.
Direct and indirect trust were combined using alpha = 0.6 and beta = 0.4.
Injected malicious users were detected using deviation and CUSUM-based checks.
Top trusted services above the 0.60 trust threshold were recommended.
Recommended services were checked against RBAC policy before access was granted or denied.
